articles.title: Tenants on Benefits – letting agent sacked after alleged remark
articles.summary: The remark may contravene the Renters Rights Act
articles.ai_summary:
- A letting agent has been dismissed following allegations of inappropriate comments regarding tenants on benefits, raising concerns about discrimination.
- The incident may violate the Renters Rights Act, highlighting the ongoing need for compliance and respect in the rental market.

articles.title: Capital Gains Tax soars as more property sellers drawn in

articles.ai_summary:

articles.title: Landlords at risk from fast-changing red tape – new study
